surveyed.source: OSM node 250624675 (memorial=statue); figures, desk and block read from Wikimedia Commons photographs (Alf van Beem public domain; Ceescamel CC0); the facing (0 degrees, +-40, from the Commons photo sight line and the plain back in the 2022 panorama) and the dimensions are estimates; the OSM node may be up to 3 m off the block

attribution.title: Theo Thijssen monument (Lindengracht) - reconstruction from photographs
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by Hans Bayens (1960); figure reconstructed from photographs by Alf van Beem, Ceescamel
attribution.modifications: Figure reconstructed (TRELLIS.2 multi-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "Lindengracht, Theo Thijssen beeld foto 1.jpg" by Alf van Beem (Public domain, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lindengracht,_Theo_Thijssen_beeld_foto_1.jpg); "Lindengracht, Theo Thijssen beeld foto 2.jpg" by Alf van Beem (Public domain, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lindengracht,_Theo_Thijssen_beeld_foto_2.jpg); "2023 Theo Thijssen door Bayens, Asd (3).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2023_Theo_Thijssen_door_Bayens,_Asd_(3).jpg); "2023 Theo Thijssen door Bayens, Asd (2).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2023_Theo_Thijssen_door_Bayens,_Asd_(2).jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model. Provenance: scripts/sculptures/rebuild-sources/theo-thijssen-standbeeld.json.
